label: Recorded-pressure HP benchmark (experimental)
scope: Same-battle calibration, not an independent validation. Held-owner folds exclude that owner death time AND damage from every fitted parameter. Only known pre-fight HP and positions are used when predicting.
limits: Pressure is an inferred HP-drain benchmark, not recovered enemy ATK or a transferable server formula.
Troop health, shield, effective healing, control and target-specific mitigation are not supplied or invented.
Presentation death intervals remain an uncertain proxy for original combat time.
The optional optimiser adjustment discounts personal offense exposure only; survival and utility score weights remain unchanged.
A position-only control performs similarly on this small sample; the HP mechanism is not established as superior by independent battles.
